title: Make a whole question the native copy unit
when: A question including its figures must copy and paste together.
do: Use one borderless 1x1 native table containing stem, diagram, choices and nested frames.
Track question ID -> table ID -> all descendant image/equation/frame IDs.
check: Every block belongs to the question; scratch native copy/paste retains descendant objects and order.
limitation: Package containment or table count alone does not prove native clipboard behavior.
